proposal.summary: A vulnerability in GitLab projects API allows pagination to be skipped, potentially leading to denial of service on certain instances across multiple affected versions.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab, versions starting from 15.2 before 16.1.5; starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
proposal.cwe_quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped, potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

AV.quote: the projects API pagination can be skipped

A.quote: potentially leading to DoS on certain instances.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the affected GitLab versions in your environment and apply the vendor-provided updates to fixed versions; if updates cannot be applied immediately, implement rate-limiting or request throttling on the projects API as a temporary mitigation and monitor API request patterns for abnormal loads.
